data.why: The repo ships ready-to-use example sgRNA tables, vector GenBank files, and stuffer sequences for all three supported cloning vectors; the app itself also has a built-in 'Load example data' button backed by its own bundled copies in PyShinyApp/example_inputs/.

goals: Design cloning oligos for a batch of candidate sgRNA sequences and get a ready-to-order IDT bulk order form
Verify that a given lentiviral CRISPR vector (e.g. ipUSEPR, lentiCRISPR v2, LentiCRISPRv2GFP) will accept the stuffer-replacement cloning strategy before ordering oligos
Generate an annotated plasmid GenBank map for each sgRNA construct to use for Sanger/whole-plasmid sequencing verification after cloning
Adapt the default BsmBI/Golden Gate overhangs (CACCG/AAAC/C) to a different vector or cloning system by overriding the sense/antisense prefix and suffix
Catch malformed input early (wrong sequence length, non-ACGT characters, duplicate IDs, PAM accidentally included) before ordering oligos

review.summary: The tree states the README's purpose faithfully (batch sgRNAs in, IDT order form and annotated construct maps out). Every task was replayed, and the nine screens I opened back the nodes with only small wording errors. Before filing, it needs the phases reordered, the display-controls phase removed, an honest note that the web app hides the per-guide and backbone error messages, and a tighter feature list (add the example-data button, reframe f4).
